demonstrated.evidence_span: The increase in routing information occurred after a routine software upgrade in one of Optus' international upstream transit networks, the Singtel internet exchange (STiX).

demonstrated.causal_note: Trigger, not sole cause. The same ACMA report finds the outage preventable and within Optus' control; Singtel publicly stated the upgrade 'was not the root cause' (Reuters 2023-11-16). Do not read as a finding that Singtel failed.

demonstrated.evidence_span: Nokia implemented this incorrect change request and adequate reviews of the likely outcomes to follow from this procedure were not made by either Nokia or Optus.
